summary: Iteration 347 - Bookings Refactor Verification. All 20 new tests PASSED + 7 iter346 tests PASSED (4 skipped due to missing sub-rooms). The refactor split monolithic bookings.py into 5-file sub-package (crud, approval, series, reporting, _helpers) and extracted notification functions to services/booking_notifications.py. All API URLs, payloads, and status codes are byte-identical to iter 346.

crud_endpoints.description: GET /api/resource-bookings (list + filters mine_only, resource_id, status, availability_only), GET /api/resource-bookings/{id}, POST /api/resource-bookings, PUT /api/resource-bookings/{id}, DELETE /api/resource-bookings/{id}, POST /api/resources/{resource_id}/check-conflicts all working correctly.

approval_endpoints.description: POST /api/resource-bookings/{id}/approve, GET /api/resource-bookings/approvals/pending-count, POST /api/resource-bookings/{id}/check-in, POST /api/resource-bookings/{id}/check-out (with mileage_after), POST /api/resource-bookings/auto-release-no-shows all working correctly.

series_endpoints.description: POST /api/resource-bookings/series with recurrence daily/weekly/biweekly/every_4_weeks/monthly/custom all working. Monthly day-clamping (31 Jan → 28 Feb) verified. POST /api/resource-bookings/combo endpoint exists and validates allowed_combinations.

reporting_endpoints.description: POST /api/resource-bookings/{id}/damage-report, GET /api/resources/{id}/damage-reports, POST /api/resources/{id}/suggest-slots (office-hours heuristic 07-20) all working correctly.

catering_integration.description: POST /api/resource-bookings with catering payload creates catering_request + auto-task. Lead_time_breach flagging and _notify_catering_team fire-and-forget working.

notification_shims.description: _notify_approvers, _notify_catering_team, _notify_catering_status in _common.py are thin shims that correctly delegate to services.booking_notifications. Used by routes/resources/catering.py (line 343) and bookings/crud.py.

router_discovery.description: routes/resources/__init__.py correctly imports `from .bookings import router` and includes all bookings sub-routers (crud, approval, series, reporting).

iter346_regression.description: All iter346 booking conflict tests pass. Skipped tests are due to missing sub-rooms in test data (splitable parents exist but no children).

code_review.services/booking_notifications.py: Clean extraction of 3 notification functions (notify_approvers, notify_catering_team, notify_catering_status). Well-documented with docstrings. Fire-and-forget pattern preserved.
code_review.routes/resources/_common.py: Lines 230-245 correctly define thin shims (_notify_approvers, _notify_catering_team, _notify_catering_status) that delegate to the new service module. Backward compatibility maintained.
code_review.routes/resources/bookings/__init__.py: Correctly combines 4 sub-routers (crud, approval, series, reporting) into single router. Re-exports as `router` for parent package.
code_review.routes/resources/bookings/crud.py: Contains check-conflicts, list, get, create, update, cancel endpoints. Uses shims from _common.py correctly.
code_review.routes/resources/bookings/approval.py: Contains approve, pending-count, check-in/out, auto-release endpoints. Clean separation.
code_review.routes/resources/bookings/series.py: Contains recurring + combo booking endpoints. Monthly day-clamping logic preserved.
code_review.routes/resources/bookings/reporting.py: Contains damage reports + suggest-slots endpoints. Office-hours heuristic (07-20) preserved.
code_review.routes/resources/bookings/_helpers.py: Contains send_short_notice_email helper for catering lead-time breach notifications.

critical_code_review_comments: Refactor is clean - no behavioral changes, just code organization
All 5 sub-modules correctly import from _common.py for shared models/helpers
Notification shims maintain backward compatibility with all existing call sites
Router discovery in routes/resources/__init__.py unchanged - import path `from .bookings import router` still works
Fire-and-forget pattern (asyncio.create_task) preserved for notifications to avoid blocking booking responses
